summary.text: John Reilly Jr. is an unenrolled candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives, 2nd Worcester District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Democrat Michael Nicholson.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as an independent candidate from Ashburnham who is a full-time father and small business owner.

paragraphs.text: John Reilly Jr. said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is a lifelong resident of north central Massachusetts and has worked in technology, media, legal services and business.

He said he was named Worcester's Best DJ seven times, worked with companies including MTV, Google and Android, worked as a legal assistant, and coached a high school softball team to a league championship.
He listed government accountability, economic development, public safety, education, and support for veterans and seniors as his main policy interests.
